title: La Union town seeks, gains landowners' help in easing highway flooding

blocks.text: BAUANG, La Union — The municipal government is seeking the cooperation of private landowners and business establishments to improve drainage systems and restore waterways in flood-prone areas along the national highway, particularly in Barangays Bakwitsur and Bakwit Norte. Recurring flooding, aggravated by prolonged rains in August and September, has submerged portions of the highway and affected nearby commercial establishments, causing traffic congestion and disrupting motorists. During the recent La Union Agkaysa: Talks and Thoughts from the Capitol program, municipal officials said consultations with affected property owners had prompted some to voluntarily set aside portions of their land for drainage improvements.
